title: ASCII Kinesis V2 Locomotion 016 — Load-Release Stride Overrun

source.identity: Bob — Bob the Builder: Fix It Fun! — Game Boy / GBC — Playable Characters

principle.name: LOAD RELEASE CHANGES ROOT ACCELERATION BEFORE SUPPORT CADENCE CAN REPHASE
principle.summary: A body already driving into external resistance does not instantly acquire a clean run cycle when resistance disappears. The planted support keeps driving, root spacing spikes, the first free probe lands long, and only successive catches can compress the surge back into a usable cadence.
principle.novelty: first locomotion specimen centered on an abrupt external-resistance change while the support domain remains feet; it studies acceleration/cadence debt rather than braking, curvature reversal, airborne handoff, support-height change, or rolling body support.

quality.correction: manifest/receipt media declaration reconciled to exact current motion+SPA bytes; authored keys/timing unchanged; official V2 manifest predicates normalized
